digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill, transition and blame machinery
propositions: rebar-debug skill closes bug tickets without recording the originating ticket in the caused_by relation, making defect escape rate unmeasurable

the fallback blame derivation incorrectly attributes defects to whoever wrote most of the file rather than who introduced the defect, and cannot see unmet-obligation cases where fix site differs from cause site

the skill must identify the originating ticket by blaming exact implicated lines, walking through carrier commits, detecting fix-site-is-not-cause-site via date test, and recording it with --caused-by on close

rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills bootstrap worktrees with bare git worktree add instead of make worktree, leaving the virtualenv unprovisioned and causing pre-commit hook failures on missing ruff/mypy

--caused-by must be supplied on bug close even when caused_by link already exists via rebar link, because _apply_caused_by unconditionally calls derive_caused_by when the flag is empty and never checks for existing edges
